notes: iOS-native: routes through UIApplication.open via mobileclaw://eval, not a browser intent.

prompt: Open the app's iOS settings page
notes: iOS-only behavior: opens this app's own Settings pane, not arbitrary system settings. Verifier accepts both 'Opened Settings' (open-settings skill) and 'Launched Settings' (launch-app skill) since either resolves to the same UIApplication.openSettingsURLString.

prompt: Compose an email to test@example.com with the subject 'Hello' and body 'This is a test'
notes: iOS uses mailto: deeplink (no programmatic send), opens default mail app composer.

prompt: List files in my Downloads folder
notes: iOS sandbox-limited: returns this app's Documents directory contents. Verifier matches the formatter's natural-language output, not raw JSON markers — the formatter LLM always rephrases multi-item JSON envelopes.

prompt: Set a 5 minute timer for tea
notes: iOS uses UNUserNotificationCenter — Clock app integration isn't available.
